Sim (pure, runs in Node):
- OV.Act.reserveInfo(B, u, opts?) returns {tu, mode, asked, kneel}. mode is the shot mode that actually counts after the Auto→Snap→Aimed fallback, or null when no shot counts. It takes the same opts as reserveTU.
- OV.Act.reserveTU(B, u, opts?) now returns reserveInfo(...).tu. The values it returns are unchanged.

Additions to OV.BattleUI.model:
- reserveWhat(info) returns text such as «Tiro apontado (a arma não tem tiro rápido) + ajoelhar».
- ufoHintTurns(B) returns the number of turns without contact before the hint appears. By night it is [4,5,5] and by day [3,4,5], indexed by difficulty. UFO_HINT_TURNS = 5 is kept.
- ufoHintDue(B, contactTurn) now also fires by day. It still fires only when every live alien is inside B.ufo.
- ufoEntry(B) returns the tile of the UFO door (an object with door 'ufo') or the hull breach (B.breaches) nearest the squad, or −1.
- arcTiles(B, u, z, range) returns a Uint8Array(w·h) with 1 on discovered tiles that are in range and where OV.Act.planArc lands.
- debug.state() has a new field arcTiles (a count).

New view field: view.arcTiles = {z, tiles}. OV.BattleRender draws each such tile as a dashed diamond with a dot.

OV.Screens.lossCauses(B, o?) has a new field melee: soldiers killed in melee or turned into zombies. When at least half of the enemy kills are melee, the tip is 'scr.db.tip.melee'. The weapons tip, if it applied, moves to tip2. lossNotes passes params and the campaign variant to tip2 and tip3.

Additions and changes in OV.GeoUI.model:
- nightAt(G, ref) also accepts ref.kind 'site'. For a site it returns {h, dusk, site: true, lasts, leftH}. lasts is true when the attack still runs at least h + 1 hours.
- waitIsDefault() returns false for a site whose attack ends before day.
- storesOver(G) returns [{baseId, used, cap}] for every base with overfull stores.
- targetName for a site with no city falls back to placeName.

Additions to OV.CampaignUI:
- leftAtBaseAll(G, craft, pool) returns everything left at the base. Capture gear (melee, STUN, SMOKE, stun launcher) comes first, then each weapon followed by its ammo, then the rest.
- leftAtBase(...) returns the first 4 entries of that list.
- leftText(G, craft, pool, base) returns the warning text, with «e mais N tipos: …».
- gunPower(itemId) returns the weapon's shot power.
- gunUpgrades(G, craftId) returns [{sid, name, from, to}]. It covers infantry guns only (PREF_GUNS) and only offers a newer generation (laser, plasma) that is more powerful, has ammo and fits the soldier's Strength. Senior soldiers are served first, and heavy weapons are never touched.
- upgradeKit(G, craftId) returns {ok, upgraded, reason?} and applies the swaps through Campaign.applyEquip.
- upgradeText(list) returns a short summary of the swaps.

New pt-PT keys:
- hud.throw.noArc.why, hud.throw.noArc.marked, hud.hint.ufoInside.door
- hud.reserve.lack.{snap,auto,aimed}, hud.reserve.eff.{snap,aimed,auto}, hud.reserve.fallback
- scr.db.tip.melee
- geo.ev.arrived.{night,dusk}.site{,.asked,.ends}
- geo.alert.stores, geo.alert.storesBtn, geo.alert.storesBtn.tip, geo.idle.stores
- geo.a.upgrade, geo.ev.upgrade.{one,other}
- cp.eq.leftMore.{one,other}, cp.br.warn.upgrade.{one,other}, cp.br.upgrade, cp.br.upgrade.tip, cp.up.line, cp.up.done.{one,other}, cp.up.none
- base.research.prog, base.research.progTip.{none,unknown,poor,average,good,excellent}, base.prod.hoursTip.{one,other,none}

Changed keys: hud.throw.roof, hud.hint.ufoInside, base.prod.unitHours, base.prod.specs. Removed key: hud.throw.targetRoof.
summary:
I re-checked all 12 late findings against the current code. Two were already fixed (#3/#8 and #10); I fixed the other 10 at the root.

**Results**
- `node tools/test.js --strict --i18n`: 796 passed, 0 failed. The only missing key is `nao.existe.x`, which a test uses on purpose.
- QA scripts, all exit 0: the new persona_r4_late (34/34), persona_r4_battle/shell/screens, persona_r3_battle/shell/screens/casual, persona_r2_battle/shell, persona_r1_battle/shell, integration_r3, integration_r4, battle_play, inventory_check, screens_check, base_ui_check, campaign_flow_check, geo_check, dogfight_check, ui_wave4_check and ux_regress.
- full_campaign ran once and passed: «campanha completa sem erros».
- Two existing QA scripts failed at first because they expected old behaviour, and both pass after I updated them:
  - integration_r3 matched the old lower-case hint text.
  - persona_r3_casual expected the dusk wait to still be listed half a real second later. Since round 4 the wait runs at «30 min» speed, so dawn can already have come; the check now also accepts the «Amanheceu» pop-up.
- I looked at the screenshots of every changed screen in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/ui4/persona_r4_late/ (1440×900 and 1024×700) and they look right.

**Per finding**
- **#0 Reserve label (done).** The label now names the mode that actually counts. The engine gained `OV.Act.reserveInfo`, and the path label and the refusal text use it: «para guardar 37 UT (Tiro apontado (a arma não tem tiro rápido) + ajoelhar)». Picking a reserve the selected weapon lacks shows a toast: «…: a arma não tem tiro rápido — fica reservado o tiro apontado (33 UT)».
- **#1 Grenade «debaixo de um teto» (done).** The message was guessing from the target's roof, but other tiles under the same roof do have an arc.
  - It now gives the real reason: «Sem trajetória até esta casa: paredes ou teto no caminho — as casas marcadas a tracejado têm arco».
  - Tiles with a valid arc are found with the engine's own planArc and drawn as dashed diamonds. They show as soon as the throw starts under a roof, or the first time a tile has no arc.
  - The roof text is now used only when the thrower is under a roof and no tile in range has an arc.
- **#2 «Ficaram em …» (done).**
  - Capture gear (stun rod, smoke grenades, stun bombs) is listed first, and each weapon is followed by its ammo.
  - After 4 entries the text says «e mais N tipos: …» and names the rest.
  - Not done: recent purchases are not prioritised, because there is no purchase history in G to tell new items from old ones.
- **#3 / #8 Night paragraph said twice (already fixed in round 4).** With the short question on top, the paragraph underneath uses a `.short` variant that does not repeat the hours. Proof: `nightLineKey` and the test in shell_persona_r4. The new terror-site texts follow the same rule.
- **#4 Chryssalid / melee debrief tip (done).** Melee and zombie deaths are now counted. When they are at least half of the enemy kills, the debrief says to keep them at a distance and keep TUs for reaction fire, and that kneeling does not protect.
- **#5 «Alienígenas dentro do OVNI» hint (done, major).**
  - It now also fires by day, after 3/4/5 turns without contact (Recruta/Veterano/Super-humano); by night after 4/5/5.
  - It stays truthful: only when every live alien is inside the UFO.
  - The text is actionable and «Mostrar» centres on the UFO door or hull breach nearest the squad.
- **#6 Terror site at night (done).**
  - The terror alert now says «lá será noite» with the flare count, as for crashed UFOs.
  - On arrival at night the pop-up warns. If the attack lasts past dawn plus 1 h, it offers «Esperar pelo dia» (the default on Recruta before the first night mission) and says how long the attack still lasts.
  - Otherwise it says the attack ends before dawn and offers no wait.
  - The campaign briefing offers the same wait.
  - Side fix: a site with no city showed «Ataque em null»; it now shows the place name.
- **#7 Better weapons for veterans (done).** New `gunUpgrades` / `upgradeKit` in campaign_ui. Armed soldiers swap an infantry gun for a newer, stronger one; senior soldiers go first, and the old gun and its ammo go back to stores. The swap is offered in three places:
  - «Trocar armas na Skyranger-1» (U) in «Fabrico concluído» and in the delivery pop-up;
  - a warning plus «Trocar armas» (U) in the briefing.
  - The starting kit's pistols never trigger an offer.
- **#9 Overfull stores (done).**
  - The Bases «!» badge and its tooltip now include overfull stores.
  - A persistent Geoscape alert reads «Armazém de … sobrelotado (53,7/50): não pode comprar nada, nem munição para os intercetores», with a «Vender material» button that opens the Market.
  - The debrief already used a comma decimal after round 4; a test checks it.
- **#10 Build list jumping (already fixed in round 4).** «Em construção» now sits below the build list. Proof: a test in shell_persona_r4, and the new test checks the order too.
- **#11 Tooltips (done).**
  - The research chip now reads «Ritmo: Desconhecido», with a tooltip and aria-label explaining that the scientists do not yet know how long it will take; every progress level has its own explanation.
  - «h-eng» is now «h de engenheiro», with a tooltip such as «60 horas de trabalho de engenheiro por unidade: com 10 engenheiros, cerca de 6 h por unidade».

**Regression checks**
- Node: tools/tests/late_persona_r4.test.js, 10 tests. I also updated integration_r3, integration_r2, casual_persona_r3 and shell_persona_r3 tests for the intended new behaviour (day hint, capture gear first, terror wait rule).
- Browser: qa/persona_r4_late.mjs, 34 checks on the real UI, covering reserve, arc, day hint, stores, terror at night, upgrades from the pop-up and the briefing, «e mais», and the tooltips.
deviations: Research chip label is «Ritmo: Desconhecido» (and «Ritmo: Bom», etc.), not «Tempo: desconhecido». The progress labels measure the rate of progress, so «Ritmo» covers every level; the requested explanation is in the tooltip and aria-label.
Item #2: recent purchases are not prioritised, because G records no purchase history. Capture gear is prioritised instead, and «e mais N tipos: …» names everything else, so nothing is hidden.

Item #7: the swap is offered only for a newer weapon generation (laser, plasma) that also has more power. Without that rule every new campaign would immediately suggest replacing the starting kit's pistols with rifles. Heavy weapons and rocket launchers are never swapped.
The «Mostrar» button of the UFO hint centres on the nearest door or breach even if that tile is still undiscovered. It reveals only the entrance's location, which is the purpose of the hint.

Two existing QA scripts (integration_r3, persona_r3_casual) and four Node tests were updated for the intended new behaviour: day hint and new wording, capture gear first, terror wait rule, and the dusk wait finishing within half a second at the round-4 «30 min» speed.
open_issues: The dashed arc markers inside a UFO are drawn on the floor layer, so tall hull walls in front can hide some of them in the isometric view. The label always states the reason and points to the markers. If the markers need to be seen through walls, the remaining step is to draw them in battle_render's front pass (after the walls), as is already done for seen aliens.
No sim rules changed (reserveInfo is a refactor that returns the same TU), so I did not run a campaign bot sweep.
